printed_header: On the school level, 173 seniors graduated from Lunenburg High School as the Class of 1973, defying the odds, enjoyed a splendid day, weather- wise, for its outside graduation program in the football stadium. Overall, school enrollment continued to remain stable with an October 1st enrollment of 2200 students actually reflecting a decrease of 26 students over 1972 figures. The projected sharp decline in elementary enrollment, however, did not materialize as expected. In the curriculum area, new programs in ele- mentary math, social studies, health education and science were introduced on a pilot basis with great care given to establishing a thorough evalu- ation of these new programs before expanding them further.
